name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Pick the 2px solid ring with 4px outer glow at 5:1 contrast. A 2px ring keeps the focus indicator visible without overwhelming the content, while the 4px glow ensures touch targets remain clear on mobile. The 5:1 contrast meets WCAG 2.2 AA for interactive elements, balancing accessibility with visual subtlety. The trade-off is a slightly larger visual footprint, but it’s necessary for reliable keyboard navigation and touch precision.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with 4px glow fails on reduced-motion: the glow pulses, which triggers vestibular disorders. Use a static 4px ring at 3:1 contrast instead—it meets WCAG 2.1 AA, avoids motion, and still works on patterned backgrounds. Test with a screen reader user on mobile to confirm touch target clarity.
